_doc: AgentLoop OTel switch. Image default = disabled, no secrets. Enable at runtime by rewriting this file (enabled=true, otlp=<endpoint>, headers={x-arms-license-key,x-arms-project,x-cms-workspace}, workspace=<id>); the watcher in zz_agentloop_otel picks it up within ~2s, patches after a 90s grace. No container restart needed.
